note: Ratchet for the structural code report (`./gradlew :peer:structureReport`). Every number below is production code that ships and does nothing: classes nothing references, methods only tests call, methods no entry point can reach, methods too big for the JIT, and severe in-loop cost findings. They may only go DOWN — raising a limit to make a build green defeats the point of measuring, so a rise fails the task. The task prints the tightened set whenever the tree improves; paste it here in the same commit.
measured: 2026-08-10 on `feat/render-on-arrival-#158` (network L-33), by `./gradlew :peer:structureReport -Pstructure.debug=false` on that branch. test_only_classes 10 -> 9 and unreachable_methods 112 -> 111, both from one cause: ChunkLockEditability -- the L-33 applier adapter that three audits found implemented, unit-tested and constructed by nothing -- now has a production construction (WorldArchiveService.chunkEditability(), installed on the worker's validation lane by PeerNode), so it leaves 2.2 and its editable() leaves 2.5. never_referenced_methods stays at 2 with no headroom: the two new control-plane parameters were folded into the existing signatures rather than added as overloads beside them, precisely so this number did not move. PREVIOUSLY: 2026-08-10 on the MERGED PR #222 review-wave tree, re-measured by `./gradlew :peer:structureReport` on the merge commit rather than carried over from any one of the five review branches. Against the validation-pass stamp: test_only_classes 11 -> 10, test_only_methods 312 -> 309, unreachable_methods 115 -> 112, from deleting SaveRegion -- the last third of the per-.mca lane, whose two production consumers (RegionSplitArchive and WorldArchiveService.seedSaveRegion) this PR had already deleted, leaving a 208-line class driven only by its own suite -- and from making WorldArchive.manifestFor(RegionId, long, byte[]) private once both external callers were gone. Re-measuring rather than merging matters for the reason round 3 made concrete: a ratchet file describes exactly one tree, and no branch's tree survives the merge. never_referenced_methods at 2 still has no headroom; both are documented in STRUCTURE.md and each is a filed defect kept fixable-by-wiring rather than deleted.
